decisive_spans.text: mid-myocardial late gadolinium enhancement in the basal anteroseptal wall

response.rationale: The presence of mediastinal and bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy, along with mid-myocardial late gadolinium enhancement, strongly supports cardiac sarcoidosis. While ARVC is considered due to RV dysfunction and syncope, the lymphadenopathy points more specifically to sarcoidosis.
